name: Sunkissed Warmth by Julia Nimke
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Sunkissed Warmth is a beautiful nostalgic recipe that works great to add a touch of analog and warm feel to your images, with the mid-tones and shadows shifted towards a comforting orange hue. Best suited for sunny outdoor situations, it makes the strong sunlight feel like a warm, inviting glow, while nicely bringing out the vivid blue of the sky. It also adds drama to sunset scenes, enhancing the rich orange tones of the dusk light.
